notes.v1_03: Top Hat: Paint the felt as smooth, soft matte deep blue-black with no brushed streaks, with a broad soft sheen on the left of the crown and rich dark indigo on the shadow side and under the brim. Make the band a smooth crimson ribbon with one soft broad highlight that stays red in its shadowed half. Soften the bright edge highlight on the brim slightly. Keep the hat, the front view, the evenly curled brim, the cyan ring backdrop and the size.
